$comment: Which curated Fluent emoji genuinely animate. Check this before using variant="animated" - an APNG that is really a still ships silently, with no error.
howToVerify: An APNG carries an 'acTL' chunk before its first IDAT: head -c 200 file.png | grep -a acTL

animated.note: Microsoft is the canonical origin and animates 746 emoji. That repo is Git LFS, so jsDelivr cannot serve it (it returns the LFS pointer) and its APNGs run ~1.4MB each. The files carried here are the same artwork, optimised, mirrored via github.com/Tarikul-Islam-Anik/Animated-Fluent-Emojis (MIT). Use Microsoft for offline embedding; the mirror CDN for web runtime.

icons.note: The Flat style is the Hoffman icon set: a complete, consistently drawn symbol vocabulary for icon and wayfinding duty. Flat is a flat-COLOUR style (about 7 fills per icon), not monochrome - the colours are part of the artwork and are left intact. Skin-tone variants (Dark/Light/Medium/Medium-Dark/Medium-Light) are not carried; the Default tone is. They remain available upstream if ever needed.

static3d.note: Base skin tone only. Vendored because 3D is the documented default style and offline deliverables (native PowerPoint, embedded PDF, self-contained HTML) cannot reach a CDN.

notAnimated.$comment: Curated names with NO animated version anywhere, including from Microsoft. Do not promise motion with these - change the emoji instead.
